## Key Details of Recent Plane Crash Reports (2013–2026)
**One Dead in Modoc County, California Plane Crash**| April 9, 2024
A 69-year-old man was killed when a single-engine plane crashed between Alturas and Likely near County Road 60 in Modoc County. The plane was an agricultural plane used for crop dusting or spraying pesticides. However, it was not carrying any pesticides at the time of the crash. Authorities have identified the victim as Peter J. Spyres of Arbuckle, California. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is investigating the cause of the crash.
**Two Killed in Truckee, CA Plane Crash Identified as Liron and Naomi Petrushka**| March 30, 2024
Two Israeli tech investors were killed when a small plane crashed while attempting to land at Truckee Tahoe Airport. Liron and Naomi Petrushka were in a Daher TBM 700 plane that departed from Centennial Airport in south Denver at 4:22 p.m. MT with a scheduled arrival time at Truckee Tahoe Airport three hours and 16 minutes later. According to media reports, the single-engine turboprop crashed around 6:40 p.m. while approaching the airport.
Preliminary investigations by the Aviation Safety Network suggest that the plane missed its initial approach to the northeast-to-southwest runway at Truckee Tahoe Airport. The plane attempted a go-around maneuver, but instead went into a left-hand stalling spiral, ultimately hitting a tree near the Truckee River.
The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) has launched an investigation, which will focus on the actions of the pilot, the single-engine plane, maintenance records, and more.
**Ontario Family of Five Killed in Nashville Plane Crash**| March 4, 2024
A family of five from King Township, Ontario, Canada died on Monday night when their plane crashed on Interstate 40 while attempting to land at John C. Tune Airport in Nashville, Tennessee. Authorities identified the victims as Victor Dotsenko, 43, his wife, Rimma, 39, and the couple’s three children — David, 12, Adam, 10, and Emma, 7.

## 2025 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **March 2025:**
*   Lanhsa Flight 018, a British Aerospace Jetstream 32, crashed into the sea after overrunning the runway during takeoff from Roatán Airport. Thirteen of the 18 people on board lost their lives.  
*   A Trident Aviation DHC-5 cargo plane crashed in a field near Mogadishu, Somalia, following a technical failure, resulting in the deaths of all five people on board.
texts.16:
## 2025 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **April 2025:**
*   Tropic Air Flight 711, a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan EX, was hijacked during a flight from Corozal to San Pedro. Due to low fuel, the pilot was forced to make an emergency landing in Belize City. Upon landing, the hijacker injured three of the 15 other people on board before being shot and killed by an armed passenger.
texts.17:
## 2025 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **May 2025:**
*   Air Panamá Flight 982, a Fokker 50 carrying 38 people, crashed after veering off Runway 27 during landing at Bocas Del Toro Airport (BOC/MPBO) on Colón Island, Panama. Of the 3 crew members and 35 passengers onboard, 12 were injured, but all survived the accident.
texts.18:
## 2025 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **June 2025:**
*   Air India Flight 171, a Boeing 787-8 en route from Ahmedabad to London Gatwick, crashed into a medical college building shortly after takeoff. The accident claimed the lives of 241 out of 242 passengers and crew, as well as 19 people on the ground. It was the first fatal crash and total loss of a Boeing 787 aircraft.  
*   A hot air balloon operated by Sobrevoar caught fire mid-flight and crashed near Praia Grande, Brazil. Eight of the 21 people on board lost their lives.
texts.19:
## 2025 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **July 2025:**
*   On July 24, Angara Airlines Flight 2311, an Antonov An-24 traveling from Ignatyevo Airport to Tynda Airport, crashed into a mountain during its approach to Tynda, Russia, killing all 42 passengers and six crew members on board.
texts.20:
## 2025 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **October 2025:**
*   Emirates SkyCargo Flight 9788, a Boeing 747-400BDSF, struck an airport maintenance vehicle and veered off the runway while landing at Hong Kong International Airport, resulting in the deaths of two people in the ground vehicle.  
*   Mombasa Air Safari Flight 203, a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan on a domestic route from Ukunda to Kichwa, crashed near Kwale, Kenya, killing all 11 people aboard.
texts.21:
## 2025 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **November 2025:**
*   UPS Airlines Flight 2976, a McDonnell Douglas MD-11F operating from Louisville, Kentucky to Honolulu, Hawaii, crashed shortly after takeoff, killing 14 people and injuring 15 others.  
*   An AirJet Angola Embraer ERJ-145 crashed at Kolwezi Airport in the DRC; all 29 people on board survived.
texts.22:
## 2024 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **January 2024:**
*   The 2024 Haneda Airport runway collision involved Japan Airlines Flight 516, an Airbus A350 from New Chitose Airport, colliding with a Japan Coast Guard De Havilland Canada Dash 8 aircraft during landing. While all 379 occupants of the Japan Airlines flight were evacuated safely, tragically, five of the six occupants aboard the Coast Guard aircraft lost their lives.  
*   Alaska Airlines Flight 1282, a Boeing 737 MAX 9 departing from Portland International Airport, experienced uncontrolled decompression when a plug covering an unused exit door blew out. Despite the harrowing incident, the aircraft made a safe return to Portland with all 177 passengers and crew surviving.  
*   A Jetways Airlines Fokker 50 crashed during a humanitarian aid flight from Mogadishu to Ceel Barde, Somalia. The aircraft ran off the runway upon arrival at its destination, striking a house and resulting in the loss of one of the four occupants.  
*   A Northwestern Air British Aerospace Jetstream crashed shortly after takeoff while transporting mine workers from Fort Smith, Northwest Territories, to the Diavik Diamond Mine in the Northwest Territories, Canada. Tragically, six of the seven passengers and crew lost their lives as the aircraft made impact with the ground 500 meters (1600 feet) from the end of the runway.
**February 2024:**
*   Air Serbia Flight 324, operated by Marathon Airlines using an Embraer 195, hit the landing lights during takeoff at Belgrade Nikola Tesla Airport. The aircraft continued to fly for another hour before making an emergency landing back at the same airport, despite sustaining a large hole in its fuselage. Remarkably, all 111 occupants on board survived without injury.
texts.23:
## 2024 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **March 2024:**
*   In the 2024 Nairobi mid-air collision, Safarilink Aviation Flight 53, a De Havilland Canada Dash 8, collided with a Cessna 172. The collision resulted in the Cessna 172 crashing and killing both of its occupants, while the Dash 8 managed to land safely.  
*   LATAM Airlines Flight 800, a Boeing 787-9 traveling from Sydney to Auckland, experienced an in-flight upset that resulted in injuries to 50 passengers. Despite the incident, the flight landed safely at Auckland Airport.  
*   In the 2024 Malakal Airport collision, a Safe Air Company Boeing 727-200 on a cargo flight from Juba Airport undershot the runway and collided with an MD-82 while attempting to land at Malakal Airport, South Sudan. All seven crew members on board survived, with one sustaining injuries.
texts.24:
## 2024 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **May 2024:**
*   During Singapore Airlines Flight 321 from London-Heathrow to Singapore, carrying 229 people, the Boeing 777-300ER encountered severe turbulence, resulting in one passenger’s death and injuring 30 others. The plane made an emergency landing in Bangkok.
texts.25:
## 2024 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **July 2024:**
*   Gazpromavia Flight 9608, a Sukhoi Superjet 100, was on a ferry flight from Lukhovitsy to Moscow when it crashed during an emergency landing attempt near Moscow. Tragically, all three crew members lost their lives in the accident.  
*   A Saurya Airlines Bombardier CRJ-200ER crashed shortly after departing from Kathmandu Tribhuvan Airport on its way to Pokhara International Airport, resulting in the deaths of 18 of the 19 people on board.
texts.26:
## 2024 Commercial Airplane Crashes:
### **August 2024:**
*   Voepass Flight 2283, an ATR-72-500 flying from Cascavel Airport to Guarulhos International Airport in São Paulo, Brazil, entered a flat spin and crashed in Vinhedo, São Paulo, killing all 62 people on board.  
*   Thai Flying Service Flight 209, a Cessna 208 Grand Caravan traveling from Bangkok to Ko Mai Si, Thailand, crashed in a mangrove swamp shortly after takeoff from Suvarnabhumi Airport, killing all nine occupants.  
*   A Vityaz-Aero Mil Mi-8T helicopter crashed near the Vachkazhets volcano in Kamchatka Krai, Russia, during poor weather conditions, killing all 22 people on board.

# BR doctor, 2 adult children killed in plane crash
Close
A preliminary report from the National Transportation Safety Board shows weather was likely a factor in the May 15 crash.
By WAFB Staff
Published: May 16, 2024 at 8:40 PM UTC|Updated: May 31, 2024 at 11:27 PM UTC
Share
Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google
NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WAFB) - A preliminary report from the National Transportation Safety Board shows weather was likely a factor in the May 15 crash that killed a Baton Rouge Plastic Surgeon and two of his children.
The report released Friday afternoon indicates that shortly before the crash, the airplane “entered moderate to heavy precipitation” soon after an air traffic controller made “several attempts to contact the pilot, which went unanswered and radar contact was lost shortly thereafter.”
Read the full preliminary report below:
NTSB Report on Gonzales plane crash by rianwafb on Scribd
The victims included the pilot, Baton Rouge plastic surgeon Dr. Lucius “Tre” Doucet, and two of his three adult children, Giselle and Jean Luc.
Giselle Doucet was studying veterinary medicine at the LSU School of Veterinary Medicine. Jean Luc was an engineering student at LSU. Both were set to graduate this weekend.
From left are Dr. Lucius “Tre” Doucet, Giselle, and Jean Luc(Doucet photo)
Dr. Doucet was flying the plane, which he owned, when it crashed around 12:05 p.m. Wednesday in Franklin, Tennessee, south of Nashville.
The plane had departed from an airfield in Gonzales, LA, in Ascension Parish, three hours earlier, enroute to Louisville. Investigators said the plane, a single-engine Beechcraft V35, appeared to have broken apart in the air, leaving behind nearly a half-mile long trail of debris.
The funeral for the Doucet family will be held Friday, May 24, at 2 p.m.
LSU released the following statement:

# BR doctor, 2 adult children killed in plane crash
> _“We have been notified that two LSU seniors, Giselle and Jean-Luc Doucet - siblings who were scheduled to graduate tomorrow were killed in a private plane crash yesterday, along with their father. We are devastated to hear this news, and our thoughts and prayers are with the entire Doucet family and all those close to them. This is heartbreaking for the LSU community, but especially for those who know and love these two students, and those who were expecting to share graduation with them._  
>   
>   
> _We will honor both students at their respective commencement ceremonies and we will do everything possible to help and support those in our community who are impacted by this tragedy._  
>   
>   
> _Any member of the LSU family who is in need of emotional support during this difficult time can contact the Student Health Center’s Mental Health Service at 225-578-8774 for counseling services. We urge anyone who needs help processing this loss to reach out for assistance.”_  
>   
> Louisiana State University

# BR doctor, 2 adult children killed in plane crash
Close
A preliminary report from the National Transportation Safety Board shows weather was likely a factor in the May 15 crash.
By WAFB Staff
Published: May 16, 2024 at 8:40 PM UTC|Updated: May 31, 2024 at 11:27 PM UTC
Share
Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google
NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WAFB) - A preliminary report from the National Transportation Safety Board shows weather was likely a factor in the May 15 crash that killed a Baton Rouge Plastic Surgeon and two of his children.
The report released Friday afternoon indicates that shortly before the crash, the airplane “entered moderate to heavy precipitation” soon after an air traffic controller made “several attempts to contact the pilot, which went unanswered and radar contact was lost shortly thereafter.”
Read the full preliminary report below:
NTSB Report on Gonzales plane crash by rianwafb on Scribd
The victims included the pilot, Baton Rouge plastic surgeon Dr. Lucius “Tre” Doucet, and two of his three adult children, Giselle and Jean Luc.
Giselle Doucet was studying veterinary medicine at the LSU School of Veterinary Medicine. Jean Luc was an engineering student at LSU. Both were set to graduate this weekend.
From left are Dr. Lucius “Tre” Doucet, Giselle, and Jean Luc(Doucet photo)
Dr. Doucet was flying the plane, which he owned, when it crashed around 12:05 p.m. Wednesday in Franklin, Tennessee, south of Nashville.
The plane had departed from an airfield in Gonzales, LA, in Ascension Parish, three hours earlier, enroute to Louisville. Investigators said the plane, a single-engine Beechcraft V35, appeared to have broken apart in the air, leaving behind nearly a half-mile long trail of debris.
The funeral for the Doucet family will be held Friday, May 24, at 2 p.m.
LSU released the following statement:
texts.4:
# BR doctor, 2 adult children killed in plane crash
> _“We have been notified that two LSU seniors, Giselle and Jean-Luc Doucet - siblings who were scheduled to graduate tomorrow were killed in a private plane crash yesterday, along with their father. We are devastated to hear this news, and our thoughts and prayers are with the entire Doucet family and all those close to them. This is heartbreaking for the LSU community, but especially for those who know and love these two students, and those who were expecting to share graduation with them._  
>   
>   
> _We will honor both students at their respective commencement ceremonies and we will do everything possible to help and support those in our community who are impacted by this tragedy._  
>   
>   
> _Any member of the LSU family who is in need of emotional support during this difficult time can contact the Student Health Center’s Mental Health Service at 225-578-8774 for counseling services. We urge anyone who needs help processing this loss to reach out for assistance.”_  
>   
> Louisiana State University
